items.title: 动名词作主语与宾语
items.brief: 缺主缺宾找 doing，作主语谓语用单数

concept.summary: 判定标准：句子的主语位置或动词、介词的宾语位置缺一个名词性成分，而所填内容是一个动作、习惯或事实，用动名词。动名词同时带两副面孔：保留动词特征，可以带宾语、被副词修饰；又具备名词特征，可以作主语宾语、被形容词或所有格修饰。单个动名词作主语时，谓语用单数；两个动名词并列则按复数处理。

sections.h: 作主语：谓语用单数，可后置
sections.p: 动名词短语在主语位置被视为一个不可数整体，即使内部带复数名词，谓语也用单数。主语过长时可用 it 占位，把动名词后置，这仅限于 no use、no good、worth、waste of time 等评价性框架。
bullets: Smoking is harmful to your health.
Reading aloud every morning helps your pronunciation.
It is no use crying over spilt milk.
It is worth trying once more.

sections.h: 作宾语：动词宾语与介词宾语
sections.p: 介词后只能接名词性成分，动词必须变成动名词，这是介词宾语位置的硬性要求。动词宾语位置的形式则由动词本身决定，enjoy、avoid、finish 一类只接受动名词。
bullets: 动词宾语：He enjoys reading detective stories.
介词宾语：She is good at drawing portraits.
形容词 + 介词 + doing：I am tired of waiting in line.
短语动词：They insisted on paying for the meal.

sections.h: 同形不同性：动名词与现在分词的区分
sections.p: doing 作主语、宾语、介词宾语时是动名词，具有名词性；作定语、状语、宾补时是现在分词，具有形容词或副词性。位置是唯一可靠的判别依据，词形完全相同。
bullets: Swimming is good exercise.（动名词，作主语）
The swimming boy is my brother.（现在分词，作定语）
He sat by the fire, reading a map.（现在分词，作状语）
I heard her singing upstairs.（现在分词，作宾补）

examples.en: Collecting stamps has been his hobby since childhood.
examples.zh: 集邮从小就是他的爱好。
examples.note: 动名词短语作主语，视为整体，谓语用单数 has been。

examples.en: She is fond of playing the piano.
examples.zh: 她喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.note: of 是介词，后接动名词作介词宾语。

examples.en: It is no use arguing with someone who never listens.
examples.zh: 跟一个从不听人说话的人争论没有用。
examples.note: it 是形式主语，真正主语 arguing... 后置。

examples.en: Seeing is believing.
examples.zh: 眼见为实。
examples.note: 主语与表语都是动名词，前后对称。

examples.en: Collect stamps has been his hobby since childhood.
examples.zh: 集邮从小就是他的爱好。
examples.note: 主语位置必须名词化，动词原形不能作主语，应改为 Collecting stamps。

examples.en: He is good at play chess.
examples.zh: 他棋下得好。
examples.note: 介词 at 后须接动名词，应改为 playing chess。

pitfalls.wrong: Read in bed is bad for your eyes.
pitfalls.right: Reading in bed is bad for your eyes.
pitfalls.why: 主语位置只能容纳名词性成分，动词原形是祈使句形式，须加 -ing 变成动名词后才能作主语。
介词 in 后必须接名词性成分，动词要名词化为动名词；介词后面永远不出现动词原形。

pitfalls.wrong: Swimming and cycling is good for your health.
pitfalls.right: Swimming and cycling are good for your health.
pitfalls.why: 两个动名词由 and 连接作主语时是复数概念，谓语须用复数，与单个动名词作主语用单数的规则不同。

contrast.withTitle: 只接动名词的动词与短语
contrast.diff: 本知识点解决动名词能站在哪些位置，那一节点解决哪些动词的宾语位置只能由动名词填。

concept.mnemonic: 缺主缺宾找 doing；一个动名词谓语用单数，两个用 and 连起来就变复数。

core: 主语或介词宾语缺名词性成分 → 用动名词
单个动名词作主语视为整体，谓语用单数
it is no use / no good / worth + doing 中 it 是形式主语
介词后只能接动名词，绝不接动词原形
两个动名词用 and 连接作主语，谓语用复数
review.trigger: 空格在句首或介词后，且填的是一个动作 → 一律先想 doing

quickCheck.q: It is no use ___ (complain). 填什么？
Reading and writing ___ (be) basic skills. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: are，两个动名词并列作主语。

drills.stem: ___ in the morning is a habit that will benefit you for life.
drills.answer: Reading
drills.explain: 句首缺主语，谓语已是 is，空格需要一个名词性成分。read 与逻辑主语是主动关系，指一种习惯性动作，用动名词 Reading 作主语。
drills.trap: Read 是祈使句的动词原形，不能作主语；To reading 把不定式符号与动名词混用，形式不成立。

drills.stem: It is no use ___ (argue) with someone who never listens.
drills.answer: arguing
drills.hint: it 是形式主语，真正主语后置。
drills.explain: 先看成分：it 只是形式主语，空格处是真正的主语内容，缺主语。再看关系：argue 由泛指的 we 主动发出。it is no use 框架后固定接动名词，与动作时间无关，故填 arguing。

drills.stem: She is tired of ___ the same questions every day.
drills.answer: answering
drills.explain: of 是介词，介词后缺宾语，必须接名词性成分，动词须变为动名词 answering。
drills.trap: to answer 只在少数形容词后作原因状语，这里的 of 已经占住介词位置，后面只能接动名词。

drills.stem: Collect stamps has been his hobby since childhood.
drills.answer: Collecting stamps has been his hobby since childhood.
accept: Collecting stamps has been his hobby since childhood.
drills.explain: 主语位置缺名词性成分，动词原形 collect 必须名词化为动名词 collecting；谓语 has been 与单数主语一致，无需改动。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Swimming and cycling are good for your health.
drills.explain: 两个动名词由 and 连接作主语，是复数概念，谓语用 are；若只保留一个动名词，谓语才用单数。

drills.stem: 每天大声朗读英语对提高发音很有帮助。
drills.answer: Reading English aloud every day helps improve your pronunciation.
forbid: read english aloud every day helps
drills.explain: 主语是朗读英语这个习惯性动作，缺主语，read 主动且泛指，用动名词 Reading；动名词作主语视为单数，谓语用 helps。help 后可省略 to，故为 helps improve。

items.title: 只接动名词的动词与短语
items.brief: 宾语形式由动词锁定，先认动词再定形式

concept.summary: 判定标准：谓语动词后缺宾语时，形式不取决于语义，而取决于动词本身的搭配要求。英语有一批动词的宾语位置只接受动名词，换成不定式即为错误，且没有语义差别可以解释，只能按清单认词。介词结尾的短语动词同样锁定动名词，因为介词后只能接名词性成分。

sections.p: 按语义分组记忆比按字母表背更牢。每组内部形式一致，都是 doing。
bullets: 好恶类：enjoy, mind, appreciate, dislike, fancy, can't stand
避开与完成类：avoid, escape, risk, finish, quit, postpone
建议与承认类：suggest, recommend, admit, consider, deny, imagine
其他高频：practise, keep, miss, involve, tolerate

sections.p: 以介词结尾的短语后面必然接动名词，这里的 to 是介词而不是不定式符号。判断方法是把 to 后面放一个名词试试，能放就是介词。
bullets: look forward to doing / be used to doing / object to doing
insist on doing / be fond of doing / get used to doing
can't help doing / give up doing / put off doing
have difficulty (in) doing / spend time (in) doing

sections.h: 两个必须单独记的动词
sections.p: suggest 与 mind 是这类题的最高频考点，因为汉语的“建议某人做”“介意去做”会直接诱导出 to do。
bullets: He suggested taking a break. / He suggested that we (should) take a break.
× He suggested us to take a break.
Would you mind opening the window?
× She doesn't mind to work overtime.

examples.en: She avoids driving at night on mountain roads.
examples.zh: 她避免在夜里开山路。
examples.note: avoid 的宾语只接受动名词。

examples.en: He admitted breaking the window.
examples.zh: 他承认打破了窗户。
examples.note: admit 后接动名词，动作已发生也用 doing。

examples.en: We are looking forward to seeing you again.
examples.zh: 我们期待再次见到你。
examples.note: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词。

examples.en: I can't help laughing whenever I see that photo.
examples.zh: 每次看到那张照片我都忍不住笑。
examples.note: can't help doing 是固定结构，help 后不带 to。

examples.en: They put off making a decision until Friday.
examples.zh: 他们把决定推迟到周五。
examples.note: put off 中的 off 是介词，后接动名词。

examples.en: He suggested us to take a short break.
examples.zh: 他建议我们短暂休息一下。
examples.note: suggest 不能接 sb. to do，应改为 suggested that we take 或 suggested taking。

examples.en: She doesn't mind to work overtime at weekends.
examples.zh: 她不介意周末加班。
examples.note: mind 的宾语只能用动名词，应改为 mind working。

pitfalls.wrong: He suggested me to apply for the scholarship.
pitfalls.right: He suggested applying for the scholarship.
pitfalls.why: suggest 的宾语只能由动名词或 that 从句承担，它不接受宾语加不定式的宾补结构，这是搭配限制而非语义问题。

pitfalls.wrong: I don't mind to wait for another hour.
pitfalls.right: I don't mind waiting for another hour.
pitfalls.why: mind 表示介意某事，其宾语必须是名词性成分，动名词是唯一可选形式；to do 会与这一要求冲突。

pitfalls.wrong: She is used to walk to school.
pitfalls.right: She is used to walking to school.
pitfalls.why: be used to 中的 to 是介词，表示习惯于，后接动名词；used to do 表示过去常常，两者结构完全不同。

contrast.diff: 两组动词的宾语形式各自锁定：decide、hope、refuse 接不定式，enjoy、avoid、suggest 接动名词，判断时先认动词。

concept.mnemonic: enjoy mind avoid finish，suggest admit consider；介词 to 后一律 doing。

core: 只接动名词的动词：enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, suggest, admit, deny, consider
短语：look forward to, be used to, object to, insist on, give up, put off
can't help doing 表示忍不住，help 后不带 to
suggest 只能接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 sb. to do
have difficulty (in) doing 中 in 可省，动名词不可换成不定式
review.trigger: 看到 suggest / mind / avoid / look forward to → 宾语位置直接写 doing

quickCheck.q: suggest sb. to do 对不对？
quickCheck.a: 不对，用 suggest doing 或 suggest that sb. (should) do。
接动名词，表示忍不住做某事。

quickCheck.q: be used to 后面接什么？
quickCheck.a: 接动名词，to 是介词；used to do 才是过去常常。

drills.stem: Would you mind ___ the window? It is rather stuffy in here.
drills.answer: opening
drills.explain: mind 的宾语位置只接受动名词，Would you mind doing 是提出请求的固定说法，故用 opening。
drills.trap: to open 是受汉语“介意去做”影响的结果，mind 不接受不定式作宾语。

drills.stem: They put off ___ (announce) the results until Monday.
drills.answer: announcing
drills.hint: off 在短语动词中是介词。
drills.explain: 先看成分：put off 后缺宾语，off 是介词，宾语位置必须是名词性成分。再看关系：announce 由 they 主动发出。介词后固定接动名词，故填 announcing。

drills.stem: She has difficulty ___ her attention on one task for long.
drills.answer: keeping
drills.explain: have difficulty (in) doing 是固定结构，in 可以省略但动名词不能换，故用 keeping。
drills.trap: to keep 是把 difficulty 当成可接不定式的名词，实际这个结构里隐藏的介词 in 决定了必须用动名词。

drills.stem: I can't help to laugh when I watch that video.
drills.answer: I can't help laughing when I watch that video.
accept: I can't help laughing when I watch that video.
drills.explain: can't help 表示忍不住，help 后接动名词，不能接不定式；若表示不能帮忙做某事才用 help to do，语义完全不同。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
drills.explain: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面接动名词 hearing；hear from 意为收到某人的消息。

drills.stem: 他建议我们提前预订机票。
drills.answer: He suggested booking the tickets in advance.
drills.explain: suggest 的宾语位置只能由动名词或 that 从句承担，不能接 sb. to do；booking 与 he 是主动关系，动作尚未发生仍用一般式 doing。

items.title: 动名词的复合结构
items.brief: 逻辑主语与句子主语不同时，必须显性写出

concept.summary: 判定标准：动名词的逻辑主语与句子主语不是同一对象时，必须把它显性写出，构成物主代词或名词所有格加 doing 的复合结构。作主语时逻辑主语只能用所有格；作宾语时口语可用宾格或普通格，但正式书面语仍用所有格。表示否定把 not 放在动名词前，表示受动用 being done。

sections.p: 复合结构整体充当一个名词性成分：作主语、作动词宾语、作介词宾语。位置的正式程度决定逻辑主语用所有格还是宾格。
bullets: His being late for the interview cost him the job.（作主语，必须用所有格）
Would you mind my opening the window?（作宾语，所有格更正式）
I don't mind him leaving early.（口语中宾格可接受）
She insisted on Tom's paying for the damage.（介词宾语用所有格）

sections.p: 复合结构的否定把 not 放在动名词之前，位置在所有格之后；受动关系用 being done，两个条件可以叠加为 not being done。
bullets: His not being invited to the party hurt him.
I object to his being treated differently.
The teacher was annoyed at Tom's not handing in the essay.
Her having been chosen surprised nobody.

sections.h: 无生命主语与 there be
sections.p: 逻辑主语是无生命名词时，通常用普通格而不是所有格，因为无生命物不能拥有动作。there be 结构的动名词形式 there being 常用于书面语，多作状语。
bullets: The door being locked forced us to wait outside.
There being no bus at that hour, we walked home.
The delay in the train's arriving annoyed everyone.（也可说 the train arriving）
there being 偏书面，日常表达更常说 Since there was no bus, we walked home.

examples.en: His being late for the interview cost him the job.
examples.zh: 面试迟到让他失去了那份工作。
examples.note: 复合结构作主语，逻辑主语与句子谓语的主语不同，用所有格 His。

examples.en: Would you mind my opening the window?
examples.zh: 你介意我开窗吗？
examples.note: 作宾语，逻辑主语 my 与句子主语 you 不同，用所有格。

examples.en: I don't remember his ever mentioning the plan.
examples.zh: 我不记得他提起过这个计划。
examples.note: 所有格 his 加动名词，ever 置于动名词前修饰。

examples.en: I object to his being treated like a child.
examples.zh: 我反对把他当孩子对待。
examples.note: 介词 to 后接复合结构的被动式 being treated。

examples.en: His not being invited to the wedding surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他没被邀请参加婚礼，大家都很意外。
examples.note: 否定在动名词前，被动用 being invited，两者叠加。

examples.en: Him being late for the interview cost him the job.
examples.zh: 面试迟到让他失去了那份工作。
examples.note: 作主语时逻辑主语必须用所有格，应改为 His being late。

examples.en: Would you mind me to open the window?
examples.zh: 你介意我开窗吗？
examples.note: mind 后接动名词，逻辑主语用所有格或宾格加 doing，不能用不定式。

pitfalls.wrong: He being late again made the teacher angry.
pitfalls.right: His being late again made the teacher angry.
pitfalls.why: 复合结构作主语时，逻辑主语占据的是名词的位置，必须用所有格；宾格只在宾语位置的口语中出现。

pitfalls.wrong: I don't mind you to use my laptop.
pitfalls.right: I don't mind your using my laptop.
pitfalls.why: mind 后接动名词，逻辑主语与动名词组成复合结构，不定式无法进入这个位置。

pitfalls.wrong: I resent to be treated as a child.
pitfalls.right: I resent being treated as a child.
pitfalls.why: resent 后接动名词；我被人对待是受动关系，因此动名词要用被动式 being treated。

contrast.diff: 复合结构中的 doing 是名词性成分，整体作主语或宾语；独立主格是修饰性成分，整体作状语，两者形式相近但句法功能不同。

concept.mnemonic: 主语位置用所有格，宾语位置可宾格；无生命名词用普通格。

core: 逻辑主语与句子主语不同 → 必须写出，构成所有格 + doing
作主语只能用所有格：His being late cost him the job
作宾语口语可用宾格，正式语体仍用所有格
否定式：not 放在动名词前；被动式：being done
无生命名词用普通格，there be 用 there being
review.trigger: 动名词的逻辑主语不是句子主语 → 前面补一个所有格

quickCheck.q: He being late made... 对吗？
quickCheck.a: 不对，作主语须用 His being late。

quickCheck.q: Would you mind ___ (I) opening the window? 填什么？

quickCheck.a: I object to being treated as a child.

drills.stem: ___ late again made the manager lose his patience.
drills.answer: His being
drills.explain: 动名词的逻辑主语 he 与句子谓语的主语 the manager 不同，必须显性写出；整个复合结构作主语，逻辑主语要用所有格 His，构成 His being late。
drills.trap: He being 把主格放在名词位置；Him being 的宾格只用于宾语位置的口语，作主语不成立。

drills.stem: I was annoyed by ___ (he) constant interrupting during the meeting.
drills.answer: his
drills.hint: by 是介词，后面要接复合结构的逻辑主语。
drills.explain: 先看成分：by 是介词，后缺宾语，interrupting 已提供动名词。再看关系：打断由 he 主动发出。逻辑主语与句子主语 I 不同，介词宾语位置正式语体用所有格，故填 his。

drills.stem: She objected to ___ like a child in front of the whole team.
drills.answer: being treated
drills.explain: object to 中的 to 是介词，后缺名词性成分。she 是 treat 的承受者，受动关系用被动式 being treated。
drills.trap: treating 是主动，等于说她对待别人；to be treated 在介词 to 后不成立，因为这里已有一个介词 to。

drills.stem: He being absent from the meeting caused a lot of trouble.
drills.answer: His being absent from the meeting caused a lot of trouble.
accept: His being absent from the meeting caused a lot of trouble.
drills.explain: 复合结构作主语，逻辑主语 he 与句子主语不同，且处于名词位置，必须用所有格 His；宾格 He 只适用于宾语位置的口语。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Would you mind my opening the window for a moment?
drills.explain: 开窗的人是我而不是 you，逻辑主语与句子主语不同，须写出 my；mind 后接动名词构成复合结构。

drills.stem: 他没被邀请参加婚礼，全家人都很意外。
drills.answer: His not being invited to the wedding surprised the whole family.
drills.explain: 复合结构作主语：逻辑主语是他而不是 the whole family，用所有格 His；否定 not 放在动名词前；他是被邀请的对象，用被动式 being invited。

items.title: 动名词的时态与语态
items.brief: 先于谓语 having done，受动 being done

concept.summary: 判定分两步：先看动名词的动作与谓语的时间先后，同时或之后用 doing，先于谓语用 having done；再看动名词的逻辑主语是施动还是受动，受动用 being done，先于谓语且受动用 having been done。动名词没有进行式，因此 doing 同时承担一般式与进行式两种含义。

sections.p: 两组参数组合：时间（一般或完成）与语态（主动或被动）。判断顺序先时间后语态，因为语态取决于逻辑主语，与时间无关。
bullets: doing：与谓语同时或之后发生的主动动作
having done：先于谓语完成的主动动作
being done：与谓语同时的被动动作
having been done：先于谓语且被动的动作

sections.p: admit、deny、regret、remember、apologize for、be proud of、be accused of 后，若动名词的动作明显先于谓语，用完成式。口语中常用一般式替代，但书面语与考试要求区分。
bullets: He denied having seen the man before.
She apologized for having kept us waiting.
I regret having said those words.
He was accused of having stolen the documents.

sections.p: 动名词的逻辑主语如果是动作的承受者，用被动式。注意 enjoy、hate、remember 一类动词后，主语常是被描述的对象，容易漏掉被动。
bullets: He hates being interrupted while speaking.
She remembers being taken to the zoo as a child.
The child enjoys being praised in public.
After having been warned twice, he stopped.

examples.en: He denied having taken the money.
examples.zh: 他否认拿了那笔钱。
examples.note: 拿钱先于否认，用完成式 having taken。

examples.en: She is proud of having been chosen for the team.
examples.zh: 她为被选入队而自豪。
examples.note: 先于谓语且她是被选的，用 having been chosen。

examples.en: The children enjoy being praised in public.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢当众被表扬。
examples.note: 孩子是 praise 的承受者，用被动式 being praised。

examples.en: I regret not having studied harder at school.
examples.zh: 我后悔上学时没有更用功。
examples.note: 否定 not 放在 having 之前，动作先于 regret。

examples.en: He denied to have taken the money.
examples.zh: 他否认拿了那笔钱。
examples.note: deny 后接动名词，且动作先于谓语，应改为 denied having taken。

examples.en: She remembers to be taken to the zoo as a child.
examples.zh: 她记得小时候被带去动物园。
examples.note: remember 后要接动名词，且她是被带去的，应改为 remembers being taken。

pitfalls.wrong: He apologized for keep us waiting.
pitfalls.right: He apologized for having kept us waiting.
pitfalls.why: 介词 for 后必须接动名词，且让我们等这件事先于道歉发生，须用完成式 having kept。

pitfalls.wrong: The old man enjoys to be looked after.
pitfalls.right: The old man enjoys being looked after.
pitfalls.why: enjoy 的宾语只能是动名词；老人是照顾的承受者，因此动名词要用被动式 being done。

pitfalls.wrong: She denied to see the man before.
pitfalls.right: She denied having seen the man before.
pitfalls.why: deny 后接动名词；before 表明看见先于否认，须用完成式 having seen，一般式 doing 无法表达这层先后。

contrast.diff: 两者形式一一对应，但参照点不同：不定式常指向谓语之后的将来动作，动名词常指向与谓语同时或已经发生的动作。

concept.mnemonic: 先于谓语 having done，受动 being done，两样都要 having been done。

core: doing：与谓语同时或之后；having done：先于谓语
being done：同时被动；having been done：先于谓语且被动
完成式高频词：deny, admit, regret, apologize for, be accused of
enjoy / hate / remember 后常需被动式：enjoy being praised
动名词没有进行式，doing 兼表进行含义
review.trigger: 看到 deny / admit / regret / apologize for → 先问动作是否已完成 → 已完成用 having done

quickCheck.q: He denied ___ (take) the money. 填什么？
孩子们喜欢被表扬怎么说？

quickCheck.a: 没有，doing 本身可表示正在进行的动作。

drills.stem: He denied ___ the document before the meeting began.
drills.answer: having seen
drills.explain: deny 后接动名词，排除两个不定式选项。看见文件发生在会议开始之前，也早于否认，属先于谓语的动作，用完成式 having seen。
drills.trap: seeing 虽符合 deny 的宾语要求，但无法体现看见先于否认；to have seen 形式上是完成式，却违反了 deny 只接动名词的搭配。

drills.stem: The pupils enjoy ___ (praise) by their teacher in front of the class.
drills.answer: being praised
drills.hint: enjoy 后接动名词，注意学生与表扬的关系。
drills.explain: 先看成分：enjoy 后缺宾语，须用动名词。再看关系：pupils 是 praise 的承受者，受动，用被动式。最后看时间：表扬与 enjoy 同时，不必用完成式。故填 being praised。

drills.stem: She apologized for ___ the appointment without giving any notice.
drills.answer: having cancelled
drills.explain: for 是介词，后接动名词。取消预约由 she 主动做出，且先于道歉，主动 + 先于谓语用完成式 having cancelled。
drills.trap: being cancelled 是机械套用被动，取消是 she 主动做的；to cancel 在介词 for 后不成立。

drills.stem: He regrets not to have taken her advice.
drills.answer: He regrets not having taken her advice.
accept: He regrets not having taken her advice.
drills.explain: regret 后接动名词，不能接不定式；未采纳建议先于后悔，用完成式，否定词 not 放在 having 之前。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He denied having taken the money from the drawer.
drills.explain: deny 后接动名词；拿钱先于否认，用完成式 having taken；take 由 he 主动发出，不需要被动。

drills.stem: 她后悔没有接受那份工作。
drills.answer: She regrets not having accepted the job.
drills.explain: regret 后接动名词；没接受工作在后悔之前发生，用完成式 having accepted；否定词 not 置于 having 之前，构成 regrets not having accepted。

items.title: 动名词与不定式作宾语的语义差异
items.brief: doing 指已发生，to do 指将发生

concept.summary: 判定标准：同一动词后 doing 与 to do 都合法时，差别来自动名词所指动作在谓语之前还是之后。doing 指向已经发生或正在发生的动作，to do 指向尚未发生、将要去做的事。stop 与 go on 的差别在于动名词是宾语而 to do 是目的状语；try 与 mean 的差别则是尝试办法与努力去做、意味着与打算。

sections.h: remember / forget / regret：时间轴在谓语前后
sections.p: 这三个动词的 doing 都指向谓语之前已发生的动作，to do 都指向谓语之后尚未发生的动作。判断只需问一句：这个动作在谓语之前还是之后。regret to do 用途很窄，只接 tell、say、inform 一类告知动词。
bullets: remember doing 记得做过：I remember locking the door.
remember to do 记得去做：Remember to lock the door.
forget doing 忘了做过：I will never forget seeing the sea for the first time.
forget to do 忘了去做：I forgot to lock the door.
regret doing 后悔做了：I regret telling him the truth.
regret to do 遗憾要告知：I regret to tell you that your application failed.

sections.h: stop / go on：动名词是宾语，to do 是目的
sections.p: stop 与 go on 后接动名词时，动名词就是这两个动词的宾语，表示被停止或继续的那个动作；后接不定式时，不定式不再是宾语，而是目的状语，表示停下来或接着去做另一件事。
bullets: stop doing 停止该动作：He stopped smoking last year.
stop to do 停下来去做：He stopped to smoke a cigarette.
go on doing 继续同一件事：She went on reading, ignoring the noise.
go on to do 接着做下一件：After the introduction, she went on to explain the method.

sections.h: try / mean：办法与努力、意味着与打算
sections.p: try doing 是把某个办法拿来试一试，try to do 是尽力去做某事，未必成功；mean doing 表示意味着、会导致，主语通常是事物，mean to do 表示打算，主语通常是人。
bullets: try doing 试试这个办法：Try pressing this button; it may work.
try to do 努力去做：He tried to open the jar but failed.
mean doing 意味着：Missing the train means waiting an hour.
mean to do 打算：I didn't mean to hurt you.

examples.en: I remember locking the door, so we are safe.
examples.zh: 我记得锁了门，所以我们很安全。
examples.note: 锁门发生在 remember 之前，用 doing，且与后半句的安全相呼应。

examples.en: Remember to lock the door when you leave.
examples.zh: 离开时记得锁门。
examples.note: 锁门尚未发生，用 to do 表示要去做的事。

examples.en: He stopped to smoke a cigarette outside the office.
examples.zh: 他停下来，在办公室外抽了支烟。
examples.note: to smoke 是目的状语，被停止的是别的事情。

examples.en: He stopped smoking three years ago.
examples.zh: 他三年前戒了烟。
examples.note: smoking 是 stop 的宾语，停止的就是吸烟这个动作。

examples.en: After the introduction, she went on to describe the next stage.
examples.zh: 介绍之后，她接着描述了下一个阶段。
examples.note: go on to do 表示接续做另一件事，前后动作不同。

examples.en: I will never forget to see the sea for the first time.
examples.zh: 我永远不会忘记第一次见到大海。
examples.note: 见到大海已经发生，应用 forget seeing；to see 指向尚未发生，与 never forget 的回忆语义矛盾。

examples.en: Missing the train means to wait an hour.
examples.zh: 错过这班火车意味着要等一个小时。
examples.note: mean doing 表示意味着，应改为 means waiting an hour。

examples.en: I didn't mean hurting your feelings.
examples.zh: 我不是有意伤害你的感情。
examples.note: mean to do 表示打算，此处要表达意图，应改为 didn't mean to hurt。

pitfalls.wrong: Remember turning off the lights before you leave.
pitfalls.right: Remember to turn off the lights before you leave.
pitfalls.why: before you leave 指向尚未发生的动作，remember 后要用 to do；turning 表示记得已经关过，与时间指向矛盾。

pitfalls.wrong: He stopped to smoke last year and has not touched a cigarette since.
pitfalls.right: He stopped smoking last year and has not touched a cigarette since.
pitfalls.why: 戒烟时 smoking 是 stop 的宾语；stop to smoke 表示停下来去抽烟，与后文再没碰过烟的事实相反。

pitfalls.wrong: I didn't mean hurting your feelings.
pitfalls.right: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
pitfalls.why: 表达意图用 mean to do，mean doing 表示意味着某种结果，主语是事物而不是人。

contrast.withTitle: 只接动名词的动词与短语
contrast.diff: 那组动词的形式是锁定的，换形式即为错误；本组的两种形式都合法，换形式改变的是动作的时间指向和意义。

concept.mnemonic: 做过用 doing，去做用 to do；stop 与 go on 看宾语还是目的；try 试办法对尽力做；mean 意味着对打算。

core: remember / forget / regret：doing 指已做，to do 指未做
regret to do 只接 tell、say、inform 一类告知动词
stop doing 停止该动作，stop to do 停下来去做另一件事
go on doing 继续同一件事，go on to do 接着做下一件
try doing 试办法，try to do 努力做；mean doing 意味着，mean to do 打算
review.trigger: 同一动词后 doing 与 to do 都成立 → 问动作在谓语之前还是之后 → 之前用 doing，之后用 to do

quickCheck.q: I regret to tell you... 是后悔告诉过你吗？
quickCheck.a: 不是，是遗憾地告诉你，告知的内容尚未说出。

quickCheck.q: He stopped to rest. 他停止休息了吗？
Missing the train means ___ (wait) an hour. 填什么？

drills.stem: I clearly remember ___ the door, so I don't need to go back.
drills.answer: locking
drills.explain: 后半句说明不必回去，可见锁门已经发生。remember 后指已发生的动作用动名词 locking。
drills.trap: to lock 表示记得要去锁，与已经锁好、不必回去的事实矛盾。

drills.stem: I regret ___ (tell) him the truth; he has not spoken to me since.
drills.answer: telling
drills.hint: 后半句说明告诉他真话这件事已经发生了。
drills.explain: 先看成分：regret 后缺宾语，须用动名词或不定式。再看关系：tell 由 I 主动发出。最后看时间：since 从句说明告诉他真话已发生，属谓语之前的动作，用 doing，故填 telling。

drills.stem: Try ___ the machine off and on again; that often solves the problem.
drills.answer: turning
drills.explain: 后半句在评价这个办法是否有效，说明建议的是试一试某个做法，try doing 表示试办法。
drills.trap: to turn 表示努力去关，隐含费力或未必成功的意味，与试试这个办法的建议语气不符。

drills.stem: I will never forget to meet the president — it was the proudest day of my life.
drills.answer: I will never forget meeting the president — it was the proudest day of my life.
accept: I will never forget meeting the president — it was the proudest day of my life.
drills.explain: 后半句用过去时说明见面已经发生，forget 后指已发生的动作用动名词 meeting；to meet 会指向尚未发生的见面。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Remember to turn off the lights before you leave the office.
drills.explain: 关灯发生在离开之前，是尚未去做的事，remember 后用 to do；若用 turning 就变成记得已经关过灯。

drills.stem: 他去年戒了烟，之后身体好多了。
drills.answer: He stopped smoking last year and has been much healthier since.
drills.explain: 戒烟时 smoking 是 stop 的宾语，停止的正是吸烟这个动作；stop to smoke 表示停下来去抽烟，与后文身体变好相反。
